close_reason: Three §5.4 guards added in handle_task_copy at task.rs (lines following the same-account check): from-account_exists check emits fromAccountNotFound; ifFromInState compared against source-account state; ifInState compared against destination old_state. Mirrors canonical jmap-mail-server email.rs:2269-2308. MockBackend::add_account helper added to lib.rs to support two-account fixtures. Three new tests: copy_unknown_from_account_returns_from_account_not_found, copy_if_from_in_state_mismatch_returns_state_mismatch, copy_if_in_state_mismatch_returns_state_mismatch. cargo fmt + clippy + test green.
description: RFC 8620 §5.4 defines ifFromInState (source-account state guard) and ifInState (destination-account state guard); both produce stateMismatch on mismatch. §5.4 also defines fromAccountNotFound when the fromAccountId does not correspond to a valid account. The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server at email.rs:2269-2308 implements all three. tasks-server handle_task_copy reads neither ifFromInState nor ifInState and never emits fromAccountNotFound — clients lose state-mismatch protection and get a generic accountNotFound instead of the spec-canonical fromAccountNotFound. Fix: mirror canonical mail-server: after validating destination accountId exists, validate fromAccountId exists (emit fromAccountNotFound on miss); honor ifFromInState by fetching from-account Task state and comparing; honor ifInState by comparing against old_state. Add tests for each new error path.
title: tasks-server: Task/copy — implement ifFromInState / ifInState / fromAccountNotFound (RFC 8620 §5.4)
